name: Javier Zarzalejos - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2018/1727 as regards the extension of the timeframe for the establishment of the Eurojust case management system
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a Commission plan to give Eurojust, the European Union agency that helps countries fight serious cross-border crime, more time to set up its new case management system. The report simply adopts the Commission's proposal without changes. It does not add new rules or ask for anything extra. The change is a longer deadline for building the computer system Eurojust uses to track cross-border criminal cases.

- **What changes:** the deadline for Eurojust to finish its new case management system is pushed back.
- **Who it affects:** Eurojust and the national authorities that share case information with it.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position goes to the Council of the European Union, which must also agree.
